## Behavior and acceptance
Given configured quotas, duration/resolution/frame limits, concurrency, retry ceilings, and a cloud spend reservation policy, when admitting work, then requests beyond those limits fail closed before paid execution. Bound Batch capacity and job runtime, explicitly handle queued/running jobs during emergency shutdown, and prevent retries from bypassing limits. A disabled cloud path still allows permitted local processing. Numerical thresholds must be selected before enabling cloud rendering.

## Ownership
Babulus infrastructure; dedicated Babulus/VideoML AWS member account

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
